Can a tested product photography prompt guarantee the same output if the model ID and seed are not recorded? Search the web and cite the sources supporting your answer.
No, a tested product photography prompt absolutely cannot guarantee the same output if the model ID and seed are not recorded. 
manuelgarcia.info
In generative AI, text prompts provide the semantic direction, but they do not control the mathematical execution of the image. Without tracking the specific model ID and the random seed number, your output will inevitably vary every time you run the generation. 
Pencil AI
 +3
Why Prompts Alone Fail to Replicate Images
For commercial product photography—where consistency in branding, lighting, and product fidelity is critical—relying purely on a written prompt introduces uncontrollable variables: 
The Random Seed (Stochastic Noise): Modern AI image generators do not copy existing photos; they start with a blank grid of completely random digital noise and mathematically refine it into a clear image. The seed is the numerical anchor that locks in that initial noise pattern. If a seed isn't specified, tools like Midjourney or Stable Diffusion automatically generate a brand-new random seed for every single run, changing the entire visual composition. 
Midjourney
 +4
Model Versioning and Drift: Even if you use the exact same software platform, AI providers continuously update their underlying infrastructure and software dependencies. Shifting from one model version to a newer iteration—or even across different platform servers—will completely change how a text prompt is interpreted, radically altering backgrounds, textures, and product angles. 
YouTube
·SelmaTeacher7 - TechGenius Tips
 +2
Platform Settings & Hardware Precision: Factors such as resolution, sampler choice, guidance scale, and even minor differences in floating-point precision across different graphics cards (GPUs) can introduce per-step randomness that drifts the image away from the original test. 
Morphic
 +1
Best Practices for Product Photography Consistency
To build a reliable, repeatable AI product pipeline, standard frameworks like the OWASP Agentic AI Guidelines recommend strictly documenting all environment variables: 
Non-Human Identity Management Group
Hardcode the Seed: Lock a specific seed number into your workflow. Keeping the seed fixed allows you to tweak minor details in the prompt text (like swapping "rose gold finish" for "chrome finish") while preserving the identical layout, lighting, and framing. 
YouTube
·Scott Detweiler
 +2
Specify the Exact Model ID: Always specify the absolute model version (e.g., Stable Diffusion XL vs. v1.5, or Midjourney v6 vs. v5) rather than relying on the platform's default current model. 
manuelgarcia.info
 +1
Utilize Reference Images: Because prompts are fundamentally open to interpretation, commercial creators often bypass text limits by uploading reference images, trained LoRAs, or style references to anchor the physical shape of the product across multiple generation runs. 
YouTube
·Cole Bielecki
 +2
